# Layouts

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Hero centered**
  - Description: The Centered hero composition: the headline, sub and CTA sit in one centred
    column in the middle of the hero. The dither field fills the whole hero (the
    'full' edge) and keeps a clearance round the text, with a rim that can move.
    The clearance traces each text line as one stepped shape ('lines') or each
    element box ('box'). Centered is a layout option on top of any template,
    never a template of its own (`composition.mode: 'centered'`).
  - Contract: [contract](layouts/hero-centered.md)

- **Hero split**
  - Description: The Split hero composition: the copy block sits at the bottom of the hero on
    a 12-column grid, with the headline and sub in a left column and the
    response line and CTA in a right column. The right column locks to the left
    one by baseline. Below the two-column breakpoint both columns stack. Split is
    the default composition (`composition.mode: 'split'`) and works on top of
    any template.
  - Contract: [contract](layouts/hero-split.md)
